stemMd:
The small workshop did not simply imitate the techniques of larger studios. It ______ them, combining familiar methods in unusual sequences to achieve effects the original procedures had not produced.

Which choice best completes the text?
explanationMd: The workshop rearranges existing methods rather than rejecting or merely copying them. Reconfigured precisely describes a new organization of familiar components.

distractorRationale.b: The methods remain in use, but in new combinations.
distractorRationale.d: The task is changing arrangement, not establishing genuineness.
distractorRationale.c: The unusual sequences emphasize variation rather than uniformity.
